entries.gloss: Two or more insulated conductors inside a common outer sheath.
entries.example_en: I need five metres of cable.
entries.notes: כבל is the sheathed multi-core thing; a single conductor is חוט. Suppliers hold the distinction.

entries.gloss: A single insulated conductor, sold by the metre off a reel, pulled through conduit.
entries.example_he: יש לכם חוט אדום אחד וחצי?
entries.example_en: Do you have 1.5mm red wire?
entries.notes: Same word as thread/string in everyday Hebrew. This is the category for rewiring inside existing conduit; כבל is for a run you lay yourself.

entries.gloss: One of the individual insulated conductors inside a cable. A 3-core cable is כבל תלת גידי or כבל 3 גידים.
entries.example_he: כבל תלת גידי או חמישה גידים?
entries.example_en: Three-core or five-core?
entries.notes: Literally 'tendon/sinew'. This is the word that lets you read a cable spec out loud.

entries.gloss: How a cable spec is said at the counter: number of cores 'by' cross-section in mm².
entries.example_he: תן לי בבקשה עשרה מטר כבל 3 על 1.5.
entries.example_en: Ten metres of 3x1.5 cable please.
entries.notes: The mm² goes unsaid — nobody says מילימטר רבוע across a counter. על here is just the multiplication 'by'.

entries.gloss: Conductor cross-sectional area in mm² — the number that decides how much current the cable carries.
entries.example_en: What's the cross-section of this cable?
entries.notes: Appears on spec sheets and filter menus. Spoken, people just say the number.

entries.gloss: Stranded-core cable that bends without breaking — appliance leads, extension leads, anything that moves.
entries.example_he: לזה עדיף כבל גמיש, לא חוט קשיח.
entries.example_en: For that you want flexible cable, not solid wire.
entries.notes: The category for a lead you terminate yourself. Often written כבל גמיש PVC.

entries.gloss: Multi-core signalling cable for switching and control circuits rather than carrying load — panels, motors, gate controllers.
entries.notes: פיקוד = command/control. Not needed for domestic DIY; shows up wiring a gate motor or boiler controller.

entries.gloss: Cable that carries load current, as opposed to signal or control.
entries.notes: Trap: כבל חשמל is the everyday phrase for an appliance's power lead, while כבל כוח on a supplier's site means installation-grade cable. Searching כבל חשמל gets you kettle leads.

entries.gloss: In distribution terms, up to 1kV — which includes ordinary 230V mains.
entries.notes: False friend. To an electrician מתח נמוך still means mains; the 12V/24V stuff an English speaker calls 'low voltage' is מתח נמוך מאוד or just '12 וולט'.

entries.gloss: Distribution voltage between LV and HV, roughly 1kV–36kV. Utility and industrial only.
entries.notes: If a category is מתח ביניים it is not for you. Useful purely as a signpost to skip.

entries.gloss: Cable that keeps a circuit alive during a fire — required for life-safety systems. Usually the orange one.
entries.notes: חסין = immune/resistant, same root as חיסון (vaccine). Distinct from כבל נטול הלוגן (halogen-free), which is about smoke toxicity rather than circuit survival.

entries.gloss: Termination and jointing hardware: lugs, glands, sleeves, ties, joints.
entries.notes: אביזר is the general word for a fitting across every trade — אביזרי אינסטלציה for plumbing, אביזרי חשמל for sockets and switches.

entries.gloss: The crimped metal end fitting that lets a stranded conductor be bolted to a terminal — the items pictured under אביזרים לכבלים.
entries.notes: Literally 'cable shoe', same metaphor as German Kabelschuh. Crimping is לכווץ, with a מכווץ.

entries.gloss: Has a braid or foil screen against interference — the tinned braid visible on the כבל פיקוד in the photo.
entries.notes: Root סכך, to shade or cover, as in סוכה. Feminine מסוככת.

entries.gloss: Has a steel wire or tape armour layer for direct burial or mechanical protection.
entries.notes: Same word as an armoured vehicle — רכב משוריין. Sticks first time here.

entries.gloss: Conductor made of many fine strands twisted together, hence flexible. The opposite — solid — is קשיח.
entries.notes: Confirmed in retail listings: Media Galaxy sells חוט חשמל שזור by the running metre, and חוט חשמל קשיח for pulling through conduit. שזור / קשיח is the live pair; גדילי is not what shops write.

entries.gloss: The metal that carries the current; also the adjective 'conductive'.
entries.notes: Causative of הוליך, to lead. מוליך פאזה = live conductor, מוליך הארקה = earth conductor.

entries.gloss: The insulating layer; also thermal and acoustic insulation in building work.
entries.example_en: You need to strip the insulation.
entries.notes: One word covers three trades: בידוד תרמי, בידוד אקוסטי, and electrical. Stripping it is לקלף, to peel.

entries.gloss: Earthing, and the earth conductor — the green-yellow one.
entries.example_en: There's no earth here.
entries.notes: From ארץ. The wire itself is חוט הארקה, colour ירוק-צהוב.

entries.gloss: The neutral conductor. Literally 'zero'.
entries.example_en: The live and neutral are swapped here.
entries.notes: Nobody says נייטרלי about wiring. Colour blue (כחול); in older installations, black.

entries.gloss: The live conductor. Also 'phase' as in single- vs three-phase supply — חד פאזי / תלת פאזי.
entries.example_en: Do you have three-phase in the flat?
entries.notes: Universally borrowed; no native word in use. Colour brown (חום) in new work.

alternatives.note: Acronym for מפסק אוטומטי זעיר. What the packaging and the electrician's invoice say; אוטומט is what everyone says out loud.

entries.gloss: The individual breaker for one circuit, in the consumer unit.
entries.example_en: My breaker tripped.
entries.notes: The verb for tripping is קפץ, jumped. Textbook case of the dictionary word being useless in a shop.

alternatives.note: Full form, on labels and in regulations. Shortened to just פחת in speech.

entries.gloss: Earth-leakage protection — mandatory in Israeli domestic installations.
entries.example_he: הפחת יורד כל פעם שאני מדליק את הדוד.
entries.example_en: The RCD trips every time I turn on the boiler.
entries.notes: פחת means loss or depletion, i.e. the leaked current. Verb for tripping is יורד or קפץ.

entries.gloss: The board with the breakers in it.
entries.example_en: Where's the flat's consumer unit?

entries.gloss: The thing on the wall you plug into.
entries.notes: Root שקע, to sink or recess — a flush one is שקע שקוע, a surface one שקע חיצוני or על הטיח.

entries.gloss: The plug on the end of a lead.
entries.notes: שקע and תקע differ by one letter and are constantly confused. Mnemonic: תקע shares its root with לתקוע, to stick in.

alternatives.note: Also 'switch', but skews to small switches on devices — and in IT, מתג is specifically a network switch.

entries.gloss: Anything that breaks a circuit: a light switch, a main isolator (מפסק ראשי).
The box where cables are joined, behind the plaster or on the surface.
entries.notes: Often shortened to קופסה in context. The recessed pattress behind a socket is קופסת התקנה.

entries.gloss: The ribbed plastic pipe that wires are pulled through inside walls.
entries.example_he: יש שרשורי בקיר, אפשר להשחיל חוט חדש.
entries.example_en: There's conduit in the wall, we can pull a new wire through.
entries.notes: Usually shortened to שרשורי on its own. Pulling wire through it is להשחיל, to thread.

entries.gloss: Screw or spring terminal for joining conductors.
entries.notes: Root הדק, to tighten — same as a trigger. The lever type is widely called by the brand name וואגו; ask for וואגו and you will be understood.

entries.gloss: Asking a supplier to cut a length off the reel for you.
entries.example_en: Can you cut me seven metres?
entries.notes: מידה = measure. The simplest counter form is just אפשר לחתוך לי X מטר? — the fuller phrase is not needed.

alternatives.note: Spoken form of the same question.

entries.gloss: Cut-to-length pricing, as opposed to buying a whole coil. The listing header is literally מחיר למטר רץ.
entries.example_he: זה לפי מטר רץ או שיש גליל שלם?
entries.example_en: Is this by the metre or is there a full coil?
entries.notes: Corrected 2026-07-29: מטר רץ is not confined to flooring and fabric — Israeli cable listings use it as the standard header for cut-to-length. Always costs more per metre than the coil: Media Galaxy sells 3x1.5 pendel at ₪6/m loose against ₪249 for the 50m coil, about 17% cheaper on the coil.

alternatives.note: The packaged coil as a catalogue unit — 'חבילה 100 מטר'. Manufacturers' catalogues use חבילה where a shop's product page says גליל.
Drum. Larger cross-sections ship on a wooden drum rather than a coil; Hashmal Yashir's catalogue marks each size חבילה or תוף. Also the word for a cable reel with a socket on it.

entries.gloss: The coil the cable comes on, and the word that gets you the whole-coil SKU instead of the cut-to-length one. Literally 'cylinder'.
entries.example_he: כמה עולה גליל שלם של חמישים מטר?
entries.example_en: How much for a full 50-metre coil?
entries.notes: This is the search term. Searching כבל חשמל returns per-metre counter sales; searching גליל or חבילה returns the coils, which are a separate product listing at a lower price per metre.

entries.gloss: A lead that extends reach, with one socket on the end.
entries.notes: Distinct from רב שקע, the multi-way strip. Israelis keep the two apart more sharply than English speakers do.

entries.gloss: The multi-way trailing socket block.
entries.notes: Written רב שקע or רב-שקע. Listed on Ivory as רב שקע חשמל.

entries.gloss: One input to several outputs — HDMI, USB, aerial.
entries.notes: Root פצל, to split. Ivory files מפצלי USB and מפצלי HDMI alongside רב שקע חשמל under one heading.

entries.gloss: Converts one connector or standard to another — מתאם HDMI, מתאם רשת, מתאם חשמל.
entries.notes: Not the same as מטען (charger), though shops sometimes label a power brick מתאם חשמל.

entries.gloss: Battery backup that keeps equipment running through a cut.
entries.notes: A Hebrew coinage that won outright — nobody says יו-פי-אס. Built on the אל- negation prefix, like אלחוטי (wireless).

entries.gloss: Surge and spike protection. Literally 'lightning shield'.
Steps voltage up or down.
entries.notes: Root שנה, to change. A 12V LED driver gets called a ספק or a שנאי depending on who you ask.

entries.gloss: Phone or laptop charger.
entries.notes: Homograph trap: מטען also means a cargo load and, in the news, an explosive charge. Context carries it.

alternatives.note: What people actually say. The full Hebrew phrase is catalogue language.

entries.gloss: Portable battery pack.
entries.notes: Ivory's own menu says סוללת גיבוי ניידת — a clean example of the gap between catalogue Hebrew and speech.

entries.gloss: Ethernet cable. רשת = net or network.
entries.notes: Nobody says כבל אתרנט. Wired vs wireless is קווי / אלחוטי.

entries.gloss: Computer display. Usually just מסך in context.
Articulating desk mount. זרוע = arm, anatomical.
entries.notes: Ivory heads the category זרועות תלייה ומעמדים — arms for hanging, and stands.

entries.gloss: Shreds documents. Root גרס, to crush or grind.
Laminating machine. Hebrew frame word plus borrowed noun.
entries.notes: מכשיר / מכונה is the generic device frame that carries most borrowed appliance names.

entries.gloss: Inkjet cartridge. Literally 'ink head'.
entries.notes: Toner is simply טונר. מחסנית also appears on some packaging but is the firearms-magazine word.

entries.gloss: Home automation as a retail category.
entries.notes: Ivory files it as תאורה ובית חכם — lighting and smart home together, which is how Israeli retail segments it.

entries.gloss: Capping request frequency against an API.
entries.example_en: The server is rate limiting me.
entries.notes: In an Israeli dev conversation the English is at least as likely: עשו לי rate limit. Mid-sentence code-switching is the norm in tech.

alternatives.note: What developers say, always. The Hebrew is documentation-only.

entries.gloss: Application programming interface.
entries.example_en: Do they have an API?
entries.notes: ממשק on its own is genuinely used — ממשק משתמש for UI is ordinary speech.

alternatives.note: Full Hebrew form, used in press and marketing copy.

entries.gloss: An autonomous LLM-driven agent.
entries.example_he: בנינו סוכן שמטפל באינטגרציה עם ה-CRM.
entries.example_en: We built an agent to handle our CRM integration.
entries.notes: סוכן also means a sales agent and a spy; in tech context nobody misreads it. בינה מלאכותית is genuinely in use, unlike most Academy coinages.

entries.gloss: Large language model.
entries.example_he: אתה מכיר איזה LLM טוב בעברית?
entries.example_en: Do you know a good Hebrew-native LLM?
entries.notes: מודל is itself a borrowing that fully naturalised, taking a Hebrew plural.

alternatives.note: 'Reading aloud' — used for the accessibility feature rather than the technology category.

entries.gloss: Speech synthesis.
entries.example_en: Which TTS is reliable in Hebrew?

entries.en: flex / cable for making up leads
entries.gloss: The standard white flexible 3-core PVC cable, sold in coils, that extension leads and appliance leads are made from. 3x1.5mm² is the general-purpose size.
entries.example_he: אני צריך גליל של כבל פנדל 3 על 1.5.
entries.example_en: I need a coil of 3x1.5 flex.
entries.notes: The missing word. Searching כבל חשמל gets you finished appliance leads and per-metre counter sales; פנדל is the product category for cable you make leads out of. Borrowed from German Pendel (pendant), via pendant-lamp flex. Media Galaxy's own description: 'מתאים להכנת כבל מאריך, כבלי חיבור למכשירים'.

entries.gloss: XLPE/NYY installation cable — double insulated, stiff, rated to 90°C, suitable outdoors and for burial.
entries.example_he: לחוץ צריך כבל ירוק, לא פנדל.
entries.example_en: Outdoors you need the green one, not flex.
entries.notes: Israeli suppliers identify cable by sheath colour as if it were the product name, and it is worth learning as vocabulary: ירוק = XLPE outdoor/installation, stiff; לבן = pendel flex, indoor, to 70°C; כתום = fire-resistant. Asking for 'the green one' is normal and precise, not vague. Colour convention taken from Amrusi's own category description — worth confirming with a second supplier.

entries.gloss: Single solid conductor — stiff, cheaper, what goes inside walls and conduit. Opposite of שזור.
entries.example_en: 100 metres of 2.5 solid brown.
entries.notes: Also the general word for rigid or inflexible, including of a person. שזור / קשיח is the pair to know; גמיש describes the finished cable rather than the conductor.

entries.gloss: Sold as the intended use on single-conductor listings: wire meant to be threaded through existing conduit.
entries.example_en: 2.5 solid wire for pulling through trunking.
entries.notes: Root שחל, to thread — the same verb as threading a needle. Seeing להשחלה on a listing tells you it is single-core wire for an existing conduit run, not cable you can lay on its own.

entries.gloss: Meets the relevant Israeli Standard (תקן ישראלי, ת"י). On a cable listing it is a load-bearing claim, not marketing.
entries.example_en: Is the cable to standard?
entries.notes: תקן = standard, תו תקן = the certification mark, מכון התקנים = the Standards Institution. Cable listings cite ת"י 60227. Worth asking outright, since non-compliant imported cable is common and an electrician will refuse to work with it.
